name: ORANO Personal Context
tagline: Read-only access to your own ORANO library, for your own AI agent.
description:
Personal, read-only MCP server for ORANO. It exposes your own ORANO library (saved projects, context, pending handoffs and memory facts) as tools so your own AI agent can use it.

Tools: `list_projects`, `get_project`, `get_project_context`, `get_pending_handoffs`, `search_library`, `get_memory_facts`.

Remote streamable-HTTP endpoint. Authentication is a per-user Bearer key (scope `orano:read`) provisioned in the ORANO app; there is no OAuth. Read-only: nothing in your library can be changed through this server.

Docs: https://oranoai.com/mcp

install.notes: Replace <token> with your personal ORANO key (scope orano:read), provisioned in the ORANO app. Setup details: https://oranoai.com/mcp
